preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or marketingWallet address
Contract must have accumulated tax tokens from transfers

exploit_hint: As owner or marketingWallet, call getAllTaxes() function to transfer all accumulated tax tokens from contract to marketingWallet as ETH. This function swaps the contract's token balance for ETH and sends it to marketingWallet without any limits. Ensure contract has accumulated tax tokens from previous transfers first.
